payload.reason: The evidence indicates that LSTM and GRU with Attention outperform other models in offensive language identification, making them the best performing methods.

claims.text: LSTM and GRU with Attention outperform all other models in terms of macro-F1, precision, and recall for both Offensive and Not Offensive classes.
Linear SVM is considered the marginally best model trained with OGTD due to higher weighted average precision and recall scores.
